problem_text:
A logistics company must select packages to load onto a cargo plane. Available packages are:

* Package 1: volume 37 m³, revenue $94
* Package 2: volume 2 m³, revenue $31
* Package 3: volume 35 m³, revenue $93
* Package 4: volume 38 m³, revenue $89
* Package 5: volume 6 m³, revenue $81
* Package 6: volume 10 m³, revenue $290
* Package 7: volume 12 m³, revenue $218
* Package 8: volume 25 m³, revenue $19
* Package 9: volume 24 m³, revenue $157
* Package 10: volume 23 m³, revenue $298
* Package 11: volume 49 m³, revenue $18
* Package 12: volume 16 m³, revenue $15
* Package 13: volume 24 m³, revenue $198
* Package 14: volume 22 m³, revenue $54
* Package 15: volume 37 m³, revenue $199
* Package 16: volume 24 m³, revenue $43
* Package 17: volume 27 m³, revenue $106
* Package 18: volume 24 m³, revenue $139
* Package 19: volume 10 m³, revenue $118
* Package 20: volume 34 m³, revenue $104
* Package 21: volume 39 m³, revenue $79
* Package 22: volume 33 m³, revenue $67
* Package 23: volume 21 m³, revenue $296

The aircraft's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 400 m³. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
